title: فصل التنفيذ والتحقق والقبول
rule:
Applies when: When reporting completion.
Separate implementation, verification, review, release acceptance and activation; never self-grant independent authority.
rationale: الخلط بين التنفيذ والقبول يسمح باعتماد ذاتي غير مخول. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
